Description: Your own side before anyone specialised. No element, no tricks — eleven people who turn up. They stack the Journeyman icon in Adventure.
Notes: ADDED BECAUSE BasicTeam.csv HAS STARS. A class with Star players is offered on the class-select screen whether or not it has a row here - without one it turns up with no description and no banner. Change these words to whatever you like. STAR TIER IV, read off BasicTeam.csv rather than guessed - the new emblem_check tool compares this column against the cards and complains when they disagree, which is how the II that was here first was caught.

Description: A scratch side of journeymen. Everybody has played against them at some point.
Notes: A LOCKED CLASS. Requires uses the same words as everywhere else in the game - unlocked:X, flag:y, count:z>=3, joined with a semicolon. Until that unlock is earned the class is not on the screen at all. Put Hidden = yes in the column beside it to remove a class outright without deleting its cards

Description: Rhine-maidens. They trade units away, turn them into swans and mark the enemy with songs - a class that changes what is on the pitch rather than hitting harder.
Notes: ADDED THIS ROUND, AND IT CLOSES AN OLD COMPLAINT. The class was fully written in its unit files and had no row here, so it turned up on the class-select screen with no description and no banner and the checker said so every run. Star Tier is the tier the three Stars hold between them - Lorelei Stars are Tier II, so a Lorelei set of nine covers I, III and IV.

Description: Fire spirits of the twelve nights. Burn counters, fusing and victory counters - a class that builds up over a match and then spends it.
Notes: Star Tier IV, so a set of nine covers I, II and III. The Star tier is READ from the Star Players file as well; this column is what a screen shows before anything is loaded, and the checker complains if the two disagree.

Description: Mountain folk. They open mines, carry Ore and spend it - a class that builds a stockpile and then cashes it in.
Notes: ADDED THIS ROUND, read off your own files: Star Tier III because Star Players.csv puts Belial, Valefor and Haures there, and the three sets of nine cover I, II and IV.

Description: Toad spirits of the marsh. They swap places, lay a cold touch on the ball and raise gravestones.
Notes: Star Tier II, from Star Players.csv. The three sets of nine cover I, III and IV.
